summary: AZIMUTH INVEST DA (org. no. 991 194 142) is a partnership with shared liability (DA) based in Bærum, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2007-07-25. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 70.200 (Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Morten Hegge.
